findings.title: No remote syslog
findings.detail: Logs are only kept locally and are lost on reboot or compromise.
findings.recommendation: Forward logs to a central syslog/SIEM.

findings.title: SNMP v2c enabled
findings.detail: SNMP v1/v2c has no encryption and community-only authentication.
findings.recommendation: Use SNMPv3 with authPriv (SHA/AES), restrict with an ACL.

findings.title: SNMP not restricted by ACL
findings.recommendation: Bind SNMP communities to an ACL of polling stations.

findings.title: 3 local admin accounts
findings.detail: Central AAA is configured but several local accounts remain.
findings.recommendation: Keep a single break-glass local account.

findings.title: Native VLAN 1 on 2 trunk(s)
findings.detail: Untagged traffic on trunks lands in the default VLAN (VLAN hopping risk).
findings.recommendation: Set an unused, dedicated native VLAN on trunks.

findings.title: 1 admin-down port(s) still carry configuration
findings.detail: Disabled ports with descriptions or VLANs are often leftovers.
findings.recommendation: Verify and default the configuration of decommissioned ports.

findings.title: 1 allow rule(s) any → any, all services
findings.detail: Rules permitting every source, destination and service defeat segmentation.
findings.recommendation: Replace with explicit sources, destinations and services.

findings.title: VPN 'outside_map 20 (198.51.100.60)' uses weak crypto (DH group < 14, SHA1)
findings.detail: Phase 1: aes256-sha1, dh5, 86400s; Phase 2: aes256-sha1, no-pfs, 28800s.
findings.recommendation: Use IKEv2 with AES-256-GCM/SHA-256+ and DH group 19/20/21 (min 14).

findings.title: 1 allow rule(s) without logging
findings.detail: Traffic matching these rules leaves no trace for incident response.
findings.recommendation: Enable traffic logging on allow rules.

findings.title: 1 disabled rule(s)
findings.recommendation: Remove rules that are no longer needed to keep the policy readable.

findings.title: VPN 'outside_map 20 (198.51.100.60)' uses IKEv1
findings.recommendation: Migrate to IKEv2 where the peer supports it.

findings.title: SNMP v2c enabled
findings.detail: SNMP v1/v2c has no encryption and community-only authentication.
findings.recommendation: Use SNMPv3 with authPriv (SHA/AES), restrict with an ACL.

findings.title: SNMP not restricted by ACL
findings.recommendation: Bind SNMP communities to an ACL of polling stations.

findings.title: 3 local admin accounts
findings.detail: Central AAA is configured but several local accounts remain.
findings.recommendation: Keep a single break-glass local account.

findings.title: service password-encryption disabled
findings.recommendation: Enable service password-encryption (obfuscation baseline).

findings.title: 1 allow rule(s) any → any, all services
findings.detail: Rules permitting every source, destination and service defeat segmentation.
findings.recommendation: Replace with explicit sources, destinations and services.

findings.title: VPN 'Logistics partner (legacy)' uses weak crypto (DH group < 14, SHA1)
findings.detail: Phase 1: aes128-sha1, dh2, 86400s; Phase 2: aes128-sha1, no-pfs, 28800s.
findings.recommendation: Use IKEv2 with AES-256-GCM/SHA-256+ and DH group 19/20/21 (min 14).

findings.title: Default SNMP community in use
findings.detail: Communities: public (RO).
findings.recommendation: Remove default communities; move to SNMPv3 authPriv.

findings.title: 2 broad allow rule(s) (any service)
findings.recommendation: Restrict services/applications on these rules.

findings.title: 7 allow rule(s) without logging
findings.detail: Traffic matching these rules leaves no trace for incident response.
findings.recommendation: Enable traffic logging on allow rules.

findings.title: 1 disabled rule(s)
findings.recommendation: Remove rules that are no longer needed to keep the policy readable.

findings.title: VPN 'Logistics partner (legacy)' uses IKEv1
findings.recommendation: Migrate to IKEv2 where the peer supports it.

findings.title: SNMP not restricted by ACL
findings.recommendation: Bind SNMP communities to an ACL of polling stations.
